welcome.title: Train your face like you train your body
welcome.body: A guided 28-day plan for your jawline, cheekbones and eyes. A few minutes a day.

goal.title: What do you want to focus on?
goal.body: You can change this any time in Settings.

options.full: A bit of everything, alternating days

points.gentle: Move slowly and gently. A light burn in the muscle is fine; pain is not.
points.jaw: If you have jaw pain, clicking or a jaw joint problem (TMJ), skip the jaw clench, jaw jut and lion face, and ask a doctor or dentist first.
points.stop: Stop right away if anything hurts, feels numb or makes you dizzy.
points.results: Exercises can tone muscles and improve posture. They can't change bone structure, and results differ for everyone.

reminder.title: A daily nudge?
reminder.body: Consistency is what makes the difference. Pick a time and we'll remind you once a day.
